mappedArea.title: Boundary-derived area
mappedArea.note: Spherical area calculated from the displayed boundary polygon, not an independently surveyed land area.

inPopulation.title: Census of India 2011, Primary Census Abstract: total population by state and union territory (Office of the Registrar General and Census Commissioner, India)
inPopulation.note: State totals transcribed from the Primary Census Abstract; they sum to India's census total of 1,210,854,977. Andhra Pradesh and Telangana are counted within their boundaries after the 2014 reorganisation (including the seven mandals moved to Andhra Pradesh); Ladakh is Leh and Kargil districts, and Jammu and Kashmir the rest of the former state; Dadra and Nagar Haveli and Daman and Diu are summed. Manipur includes the census estimate for its three uncounted subdivisions.
